parameters.rowKey: Tells rows apart when rows is replaced (the row itself unstated).
parameters.pageSize: Limits the number of rows on each page.
parameters.query: Supplies the text used to filter rows.
parameters.filter: Decides whether a row matches the current query.
parameters.onSelectionChanged: Called with the selected rows as the selection changes.
parameters.onRowActivated: A row's Enter, or its press when the table does not select.
